response.sql:
WITH eligible_films AS (
  SELECT f.film_id, f.original_language_id, f.rental_rate, f.rental_duration
  FROM film AS f
  WHERE f.replacement_cost >= 20.99
)
SELECT original_language_id,
       AVG(rental_rate / rental_duration) AS avg_rate_per_rental_day,
       COUNT(*) AS film_count
FROM eligible_films
GROUP BY original_language_id
ORDER BY film_count DESC
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: “Meet the cutoff” means replacement_cost is at least 20.99.

alternatives.interpretation: If the cutoff means replacement_cost is at most 20.99, use this query instead.

  SELECT f.film_id, f.original_language_id, f.rental_rate, f.rental_duration
  FROM film AS f
  WHERE f.replacement_cost <= 20.99
)
SELECT original_language_id,
       AVG(rental_rate / rental_duration) AS avg_rate_per_rental_day,
       COUNT(*) AS film_count
FROM eligible_films
GROUP BY original_language_id
ORDER BY film_count DESC
LIMIT 10;
